stem.en: Kabir attacks. Pick his best card.

text.en: "You have described what the seed spends the coins on, but you have not said how it knows what to build. An engine cannot build an engine. Neither can a pile of enzymes, unless something tells them the order of the beads. Where is that?"
"The engine catches energy and has a load, so by Book III it is alive."

feedback.en: Book III said a living thing must have a load. It did not say a load is enough. The engine has one and spends it outside itself.

text.en: "The seed only catches a third. The engine is just a worse seed."

feedback.en: The engine catches a tenth. And efficiency was never the line; what the caught energy is spent on is.

image.alt: A boy playing his best card in a duel over a notebook page showing the flame-and-seed energy ledger, a toy steam engine and a peanut on the table.
